title: HSI's Operation Renewed Hope uses facial recognition and AI image enhancement to identify 311 probable child victims in cold cases
summary: A three-week HSI-led surge from 17 Jul 2023 produced 311 probable identifications of unknown child victims, 14 positive contacts and several rescues; officials credit facial recognition and AI images.
account: The operation began on 17 July 2023 and ended in early August. HSI's Cyber Crimes Center hosted investigators from the FBI, U.S. Marshals, Interpol, Europol and 13 foreign agencies to review unidentified child sexual abuse material series. ICE reports 311 probable identifications of previously unknown victims, 14 positive contacts and several confirmed rescues from active abuse. Over 100 leads went to field offices and 25 countries, with arrests already made in the United States and Canada. NBC News reports that HSI officials credited new facial recognition and artificial intelligence technology for fresh leads. Mike Prado of HSI described AI- or machine-learning-enhanced images as a starting point for investigation. ABC (Australia) reports that the operation used Clearview AI's facial recognition alongside other techniques, citing Queensland Police analyst Scott Anderson. Forbes reports that officials did not confirm Clearview or any specific program. The ICE release itself does not mention AI.
purpose: Identify previously unknown victims and offenders in seized child sexual abuse material so that children can be located and rescued.
system: Facial recognition (reported as Clearview AI) and AI/machine-learning image enhancement used in victim identification
developer: Clearview AI (reported by ABC and Forbes; not confirmed by HSI) and unnamed image-enhancement tools
deployer: Homeland Security Investigations (U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement), Cyber Crimes Center
domain: Child protection / online child sexual exploitation

ratings.reason: ICE reports several confirmed rescues of children from active abuse and 14 positive contacts. The number of rescues is unstated.
More than 100 leads disseminated and arrests of active abusers in the United States and Canada, per ICE and NBC.

ai_role.statement: Official and independent sources agree the surge produced the identifications. The AI's share is described only qualitatively. NBC quotes an HSI official on AI-enhanced images giving investigators a starting point or tentative identification. ABC names Clearview AI's facial recognition as one tool. HSI did not confirm any product, and much of the work was manual contextual analysis (flora, fauna, geolocation). No figure separates AI-derived identifications from the rest.
